<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>NSE IPO Approval:</strong> SEBI has granted the long-awaited regulatory nod for the National Stock Exchange’s ₹30,000 crore IPO, which is expected to be the largest public issue in India to date, with a potential listing by the end of September.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I7</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I27</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Market Rebound:</strong> Indian indices snapped a four-day losing streak, with the Sensex gaining over 360 points to close at 76,515 and the Nifty testing the 23,900 level, supported by a strong net buying of ₹8,930 crore by DIIs despite FII selling.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiuAFBVV95cUxPQ0k5RWNzbEtMRlRPbEgwZ1BOVmx6eXh0QUJNOWxBQTJVSlZGRzkwbHQzRXkySnB5ZExuODktQmFRdEFRbERQZHY5aF84QjhhaW9sYXU2OGVlV29HYXJmMjJIQW9TTTVxNjNtemVsZkhKMnUxZHprZzVFRDE5OWZEUC1RLWZ4MV9OdFNDNTVBT2hzbmFDRGRHc2YwUTNoMUJCZ0RIdEZMaXA0eFN3ajdnaEFGcDBON1VF0gG-AUFVX3lxTE5lUElueTFqbWVhckU3NWVlVk9LOVhBSWdrQmFwQm1zUGdNb2RHRzZJVXNhSmVUXzZaT3lHemZtZXc1OFpwV3NWSUt0RU9wZ1Z5SzhadG1RQUEtdFQ2VG83YzVNeVpYQVppWkJVZVpBRDREVU5wSlc5dmdQSTZWanF5UHNSb1pQWmo2Y091OTJ5dUc3LUxSSUI2VDlTdUJ5dnZ5aDJNYmN4bGRYcjZYdWZrSmJhcVkxa0tOaFhNYmc?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I49</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>RBI Policy Outlook:</strong> Analysts suggest the RBI may resume a rate hike cycle starting in December, potentially pushing the repo rate to 5.75%–6% by the second half of FY27 to manage excess liquidity.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiekFVX3lxTE9lZHBuUXY2eWc4SzdvQUJ6MW5iY1BUUDFxSU9mX04zRHpIcVZUOXY3ZzdwbmwtMjhWZFN3NzllLUhFU0RPeDh2QXJFYkZkekl4WHFSUXdRVDJtM1AxeDQ0NThyM00xN0pfRzEwOGlNX21TYW9US3ZPNjRn?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I41</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I47</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>SEBI Regulatory Proposals:</strong> SEBI is considering allowing net settlement of cash-market transactions for mutual funds to alleviate liquidity pressures, while also reviewing derivatives settlement methodologies following the CAS rollout.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiyAFBVV95cUxNNFN2dV9sNnBJV2xQbXNiZ0ZrRUJSYkJUX0NxaUZjekZRVFpiWVUyRWF3VW5zN3VheXpDbUtZNGNkeGt6VkJ5WlB4cDY1enNKcm44UktpZ2JqYV8yQ0dDSFRfRWNabnotODZYUzlvNUV5UW9HZkZfN3FlQnhkbXBRZWxtYlBFMmhzMlh4U1FOVUxLZV9Dc1FZZDV2MXRWWWREdmZIdWMtWnVwLXhiYzNPdVZRVHNVaDZLd3hVbEM3RndIRFQ4V01SRQ?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I36</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I55</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMixAFBVV95cUxOVHhlT3BtNGxuYnNKbGoyaDlTRmpOZG1IQ0hGVXdVVmJzdlo3VlJnb05RbjZJWndCVHFHbktucnF0dUdTMFZGckt0bjBkQTYxVXh5dm5YUFB6dmg0NlF5VTZscVB6UU0wcnRYSmNrWEZRODY2Y0VsRFppOGlsdmxnOVpzUERUbzM1OEtHemVweHhHa0Y0RmtBcHJnODBjYm5pYWwtU0RhNVJpT3lxRFhhZ0RpUDZqOFAtVUZZaUwzNDlqU2NY?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I60</a></span></li>
</ul>
